source: Original Web Audio synthesis; no imported recordings

checks.name: no context or playback before a user click
real Chrome click starts nonzero audio output
same-page repeated creation reuses one engine
mix and mute persist without autoplay after reload
music and effects buses independently produce audio
another same-origin tab takes ownership without double playback
user can reclaim audio in the first tab
visibility pause and return resume preserve one context
all effects and ending transitions execute without browser errors
42-second original stereo sample renders with headroom and no clipped frames

limits: Browser audio rendering and waveform measurements are not human headphone/speaker listening.
Hidden-tab pause is tested with a visibility event and hidden-property fixture; real OS tab suspension varies.
Spatial presence is a zone-based stereo mix, not measured surround acoustics.
